subject: Post-demo: Hosted quickstart checklist, rate profile & data residency questions
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@finlytics.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T15:12:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: Hosted quickstart checklist, rate profile & data residency questions

Hi Elena / Daniel —

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciated the candid discussion on where Finlytics is headed with real-time report generation. Short recap and a few follow-ups so we can scope the Hosted evaluation properly: 

Recap (from our demo)
- You want low-latency scoring for report generation (single-turn prompts that average ~2k output tokens) and a batching-friendly ingest for bulk re-scoring.
- Priority: get a working Hosted pilot quickly (sandbox endpoints) to validate latency/cost before deciding on Dedicated.
- Compliance note: logs & residency are important for next-step procurement.

Questions / Asks
1) Deployment preference: you indicated Hosted to start — confirm expected decision timeline to move to Dedicated/private if pilot goes well (approx weeks?).
2) Traffic profile: can you confirm steady-state and peak requirements (requests/sec, average tokens in/out)? I sketched numbers below — please correct.
   - steady: ~50 rps
   - peak bursts: ~250 rps for short windows
   - average request size: 2k output tokens, 300 input tokens
3) Data residency / logs: do you need logs stored in a specific region or a VPC integration for audit logs? Any SOC2 evidence needed during pilot?
4) Quickstart access: we'll provision sandbox keys and two endpoints (inference + streaming). Any IP allowlist we should use?

Next steps I propose
- I will share our Hosted Quickstart Playbook (attached) and a short rate-profile template for you to fill out.
- Marcus (cc'd) will provision sandbox endpoints once you confirm the allowlist and preferred region.
- Quick sync next week to agree on the mutual action plan (MAP) and success criteria.

If you prefer, we can also scope a Dedicated trial path in parallel — that would require a 2–4 week provisioning lead time.

Thanks —

Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: hosted-quickstart-playbook.pdf, rate-profile-template.xlsx
From: Elena Soto <elena@finlytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@finlytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Hosted quickstart checklist, rate profile & data residency questions

Thanks Soojin — great demo, and happy to move forward with a Hosted evaluation to validate latency/cost. Answers inline below.

- Decision timeline: we expect to decide on Hosted pilot this week; production decision (Hosted vs Dedicated) targeted in 6–8 weeks after pilot metrics.

- Traffic profile (approx, per our infra team):
  * steady: 40–60 rps (mostly daytime US)
  * planned bursts: up to ~200 rps for 5–10 minute windows during batch runs
  * average tokens: input ~350, output ~1800–2200
  * concurrency: typical 25 concurrent sessions, bursts to 200

- Data residency & logs: we need logs retained for 90 days and stored in a US region only. For the pilot, we need access to request/response audit logs (redacted if necessary). SOC2 reports: we can accept SOC2 Type II summary for Hosted; procurement will request detailed evidence later.

- Allowlist: yes — we'll provide 3 static IPs for allowlisting.

Extra asks: 
- Can you confirm default Hosted rate limits per API key during pilot, and how to request temporary burst increases?
- Does Redwood support prefix (KV) caching on Hosted endpoints to reduce token consumption for repeated prompts?

Happy to jump on a short call Friday to finalize the MAP.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Platform | Finlytics
elena@finlytics.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@finlytics.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Hosted quickstart checklist, rate profile & data residency questions

Thanks Elena — that profile is really helpful. Quick clarifications and commitments below: 

1) Timeline: noted — we'll treat this as a 6–8 week decision window for production. For the pilot, aim for a 2-week hosted validation.

2) Hosted defaults & burst policy:
   - Default sandbox rate limits: 60 rps, token soft-limit 10M tokens/day (adjustable).
   - Production Hosted: baseline rate limits paired to account tier; we can temporarily lift rate caps for short bursts with a 24–48 hour advance request. For immediate short bursts during pilot we can open a managed "burst window" once we see initial telemetry (Marcus will coordinate).

3) KV / prefix caching on Hosted:
   - Yes, Hosted supports prefix/KV caching on inference paths. It can be enabled per-endpoint and generally reduces repeated token cost by 30–60% depending on prompt shape. We'll include recommended config in the playbook.

4) Logs & residency:
   - We can retain request/response metadata and redacted payloads for 90 days in a US region. For SOC2 evidence, we'll share our attestation summary; procurement can request deeper artifacts through an NDA.

5) Sandbox provisioning ask list (what we need from you):
   - IP allowlist (3 IPs)
   - Region preference (us-east-1 or us-west-2)
   - Example traffic csv (a short sample or the completed rate-profile-template.xlsx)

Next steps
- Marcus will provision two sandbox endpoints (inference + streaming) and create sandbox API keys (ETA: within 24 business hours after we get the allowlist).
- I'll schedule a 30-min MAP call for Friday to lock success criteria and pilot tasks.

Marcus — can you confirm ETA to provision once we have the allowlist/region? I'll send the calendar invite after Elena confirms Friday availability.

Thanks —
Soojin
